_meta.description: The detections lane model: YARA's native rule string moves under yara.rule to avoid colliding with the ECS rule object, with yara.match_count and yara.strings_truncated alongside, and the YARA string-match list mapped flattened. Hayabusa, the EVTX detection engine that also rides this lane, carries its own logs-dxdfir@hayabusa model.
